title: Bear Raid
description: From 5:00, red arrows flash on one edge, then a wall of grizzlies charges straight across the screen with one gap in the line: find it or get trampled (grizzlies already end 31% of runs).

title: Liquidation Cascade
description: Kill 30 bears inside 5 s and for the next 3 s every kill pops in a small blast that chains through the crowd, with a combo counter climbing on screen.

title: The Hodl Hamster
description: A new playable character: an original hamster that starts with a spinning wheel that rolls over bears around it, with more HP and slower feet (Pepe played 83% of Build #16's runs).
